html:
Reflexive and sensorimotor stage at the beginning; executing basic actions and discovering basic representations to explain the immediate 4D world (which support higher-order representations through both grounding and analogical transfer (e.g grandma is "above" mom in the family "tree"))

Stages are recursive

Takes longer and longer to move from one stage to the next

Inhabitance of stages follows a bell curve (stages likely correlate strongly with IQ)
